abstract: We investigated the expression of thrombomodulin (TM) on endothelium in some pathologic states. We used the cultured endothelial cells treated with interleukin-1 (IL-1) and propagated cells by serial subculture for extended periods of time and assessed cell-surface TM molecules. We also studied the distribution of TM on surgical specimens of chorionic diseases, angiosarcoma and on several established cell lines of human choricarcinoma. Subculture of human umbilical vein endothelial cells (HUVE) up to 2 months (approximately 16 subcultures) decreased the number of cell-surface TM molecules by approximately 20% compared to the primary culture. The number of TM molecules also decreased on HUVE treated by IL-1. The treatment of the cells with IL-1 also induced change of shape. TM was found not only normal syncytiotrophoblast but also on neoplastic syncytiotrophoblast of choriocarcinoma and hydatidiform mole. However, TM was not expressed on the three established cell lines. TM was found on various types of vascular tumors, including angiosarcoma.
abstract_ja: 病態下での内皮細胞におけるトロンボモジュリン(TM)の発現について検討した。インターロイキン1(IL-1)で処理した培養内皮細胞、および長期継代を行った培養内皮細胞を用い、細胞表面のTM分子を評価した。ヒト臍帯静脈内皮細胞(HUVE)を約2か月（約16回継代）継代すると、初代培養と比べて細胞表面のTM分子数は約20%減少した。IL-1処理によってもHUVE上のTM分子数は減少し、細胞は形態変化も示した。また、絨毛性疾患の手術検体、血管肉腫、およびヒト絨毛癌の樹立細胞株におけるTMの分布も検討した。TMは正常の合胞体栄養膜細胞だけでなく、絨毛癌および胞状奇胎の腫瘍性合胞体栄養膜細胞にも認められた。一方、樹立された3種の細胞株ではTMは発現していなかった。TMは血管肉腫を含む種々の血管腫瘍にも認められた。
